svg.title: Storage at a glance
svg.desc: Three storage zones: authoritative files under the data directory, PostgreSQL with authoritative rows and derived search projections, and instance-local recovery files. Headless workflow runs replace the PostgreSQL rows with a file checkpoint under data_dir/standalone/.

g.text: Hover a store for what it holds and how it is written; its connections light up. Click it to open its section.
Inside a rendered document this image is static. Click it to open the interactive SVG.

svg.text: Files and PostgreSQL are the two authorities. Search rows are derived from files and rebuilt, never the reverse.

g.text: sessions/<uuid>/ · one directory per session: metadata and the append-only transcript; .session_keys.json indexes deterministic session keys
MessageService writes through a queue, so a transcript has one writer. The conversation search rows are rebuilt from these NDJSON files.
workspace/ · agents/<id>/ · MemoryCorpusService owns the canonical Markdown per principal (owner, agent:<id>); its manifest is rebuilt
Search rows for these corpora are derived and rebuilt from the Markdown (dartclaw rebuild-index); the files never depend on PostgreSQL.
dartclaw.yaml · kv.json · operator configuration and the global key-value store
kv.json also holds daily usage summaries. Standalone runs keep their own kv.json under data_dir/standalone/.
audit-YYYY-MM-DD.ndjson · guard audit is date-partitioned (guard_audit.max_retention_days, default 30, 0 keeps all) and append-only
Entries are not hash-chained or signed. usage.jsonl rotates by size instead of by date.
each written as temp file + rename
Small atomic documents · channel thread bindings, the runtime project registry and parked schedule changes
A crash leaves either the old or the new document, never a torn one.
conversation_chunks · lexical projection of chat-facing messages, rebuilt from the session NDJSON
Results are re-authenticated against current content before publication. Vector rows exist only in hybrid search mode.
memory_chunks · lexical projection of canonical memory, one corpus per principal
Reconciled at startup by CanonicalIndexReconciler; a failed reconcile is logged and canonical memory stays available.
Authoritative rows · the relational record: tasks, goals, executions, workflow runs, traces, task events, knowledge-graph facts
turns is written fire-and-forget by TurnTraceService; task_events is awaited by TaskEventService before the bus event is emitted.
PostgresBackend · prepared statements and asynchronous transactions behind the DatabaseBackend port, shared by every repository and index
The schema gate admits an empty database, the exact current schema or one released transition; every other shape is refused without mutation.
turn_state.json · records of active turns, read before PostgreSQL opens so orphaned turns are found
Transient and instance-local: a lost file starts empty. Serving runners acknowledge the orphan records after storage wiring returns.
webhook_deliveries/ · one marker file per inbound webhook delivery id, claimed exclusively so a redelivery is dropped
Instance-local and purged by TTL; a lost directory starts empty.
standalone/ · headless workflow runs keep tasks, runs, traces and sessions in files under standalone/, behind the same repository contracts
One execution process owns the directory through StandaloneExecutionLease; a malformed checkpoint refuses to load and is never reset.
